verdict.rationale: Gitea ships as a single binary that runs headlessly on any OS/architecture without a GUI, has a documented CLI ('tea'), full REST API/webhooks, and Actions for GitHub-Actions-style CI/CD YAML workflows — all evidenced by docs and confirmed by community reports of simple docker/binary deployment and automated upgrades. missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'headless mode' or CI-automation tutorial, and no independent benchmark of running Gitea itself inside a CI pipeline.
